text:
jordan_csm: Hey team — weekly health check for Thermaledger. Quick topline: cache hit down ~3pp week-over-week, avg batch size ~2.1, cost per 1k tokens up ~18%. Looking for quick mitigation plan.
marie_cs: Adding numbers from billing & metrics. main pain is token spend spike on inference for support flows.
marie_cs: Summary: `7d active users ~18k`, `total tokens/day ~2.1M`, `hit_rate: 68.2%`, `avg_batch_size: 2.1`, `cost_per_1k_tokens: $4.73`.
akshay_se: thanks — is the hit rate regression steady or a single-day blip?
jordan_csm: steady since Wed, small daily decline. baseline last month was ~71-72%.
dana_eng: probably two things: recent prompt tweak increased unique prefixes, and batch window lowered after autoscale tweak. can confirm if batching window moved from 50ms -> 20ms? @akshay_se any deploys?
akshay_se: I did a small runtime tweak on Tuesday to reduce max wait to 20ms for latency SLOs. that would drop batch size. i can revert to 50ms for Thermaledger route if we accept a ~5–10ms p99 bump.
marie_cs: customer is okay with slight p99 increase if it brings cost down. they flagged renewal signal but prefer stability + cost predictability.
dana_eng: action proposal: 1) roll back wait to 50ms for the `thermaledger-support` route, 2) enable prefix caching for common support prompts (TTL 12h), 3) run a 48h cost test and measure cost/1k.
akshay_se: +1. I can do rollback now and add a flagged config for just that route. will monitor batch size/latency.
opsbot: deploy-bot: Rollback started by akshay_se for `thermaledger-support` config (change-id: rb-20240609-03).
opsbot: deploy-bot: Rollback complete.
akshay_se: rollback done. observed avg_batch_size increase to 3.9 over the last 20 minutes, p99 up ~7ms.
jordan_csm: great — marie, can you update the customer that we're rolling back batching wait and enabling caching?
marie_cs: pinged them in email thread + created enablement doc with suggested prompt templates to improve cacheability. link: https://redwood.company/enablement/thermaledger-caching (internal)
dana_eng: I'll open a small runbook to toggle wait/window and cache TTL for ops to use if they request further tuning. also adding a metric alert: `batch_avg_size < 3` for 30m window for that tenant.
akshay_se: note: we should also surface token distribution by prompt type. i'll attach a query later.
jordan_csm: ok set of actions — timeline: rollback done, cache templates sent, runbook + alert created, 48h cost test starts now. we'll reconvene in 48h. thanks all :thumbsup:
marie_cs: thanks — looping in account exec for renewal touchpoint.
opsbot: monitor-bot: alert created: `thermaledger.batch_avg_size` threshold 3 -> notifying eng-oncall.
akshay_se: adding snippet of the metrics query I used:
```
/query metrics --tenant thermaledger --range 7d --filters "route:thermaledger-support" --fields hit_rate,avg_batch_size,cost_per_1k
```
jordan_csm: cool. will capture outcome in next weekly thread. closing for now. :white_check_mark:
